types.name: lending-position adjustment with swaps
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: swap events plus a lending-position event, without a matched flash-loan pair
types.what: Collateral or debt changes alongside a trade. A positive cash balance can be released collateral or newly borrowed inventory rather than arbitrage income; inspect supply, debt and withdrawal records separately.

types.name: Dolomite margin-account deposit
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: official DolomiteMargin Ethereum address, documented LogDeposit topic and incoming assets; decode account, market, deltaWei and newPar
types.what: USDC passes through a deposit proxy into DolomiteMargin, which credits a numbered account. The account balance is an internal signed principal record, so a second ERC-20 share transfer is not required. The two transfer legs are one deposit.

types.name: Relay depository settlement withdrawal
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: RelayCallExecuted emitted by the documented Ethereum depository plus a positive token outflow from that address
types.what: An allocator-authorized execute call releases escrowed tokens to a solver or nominated recipient. This is settlement inventory returning from the depository; it does not by itself prove a new user bridge withdrawal.

types.name: deposit into Relay settlement escrow
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: Relay deposit event from the documented Ethereum depository plus an incoming priced leg
types.what: Tokens or native ETH enter the depository and an order identifier is recorded. A separate solver fill and settlement can happen later; destination execution is outside this Ethereum-only study.

types.name: Aster trading-treasury deposit
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: observed deposit topic at the documented Ethereum Aster treasury plus incoming value
types.what: A user funds the documented trading treasury. A balance claim is created in the trading system; this transfer does not show a trade, a leverage change or a profit.

types.name: Aster trading-treasury payout
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: observed withdrawal topic at the documented Ethereum Aster treasury plus outgoing tokens
types.what: The treasury releases tokens to a beneficiary following a relayed instruction. Ethereum records the payout, not the preceding account PnL or trades.

types.name: CCIP token-send request on Ethereum
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: documented Ethereum CCIP router and ccipSend selector, message event, and a sender token outflow
types.what: A sender locks tokens in a token pool and pays a separate message fee through the CCIP router. The emitted message proves initiation, not delivery on the other chain.

types.name: contract-account token execution
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: one of three observed execution selectors; only Transfer/Approval events; all priced legs are token outflows from the called account
types.what: The fee-paying sender instructs an account contract to move its token inventory to one or several recipients. Separating caller, asset owner and beneficiary prevents counting the relayer as the payer. Exchange ownership is unresolved.

types.name: operator-mediated token-transfer batch
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: observed helper address, four-array selector and completion topic, with direct non-mint token legs outside the helper
types.what: A helper moves tokens directly between third-party addresses. The transaction sender and helper can both have zero token net. The $20M example is a single USDT movement under a batch interface, not $20M owned by the gas payer.

investigation.interpretation_limit: Cash deltas omit debt and collateral claims. They are not profit.

types.name: flash-funded lending-position adjustment
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: event-supported flash pair plus lending supply/borrow/repay/withdraw events
types.what: Temporary borrowing enables a lending-position change. Read collateral and debt events separately from repayment of the temporary loan; a negative cash net may be newly supplied collateral, not a trading loss.

types.name: liquidity management with an embedded swap
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: swap events and mint/burn/collect/modify-liquidity events in the same transaction
types.what: One transaction combines a trade with a liquidity change. The swap can rebalance inventory used by the position; trading and liquidity legs must be investigated together.

types.name: collection of tokens owed to a liquidity position
types.origin: five-hour LLM investigation; round_01 packets and qual_notes.md, 2026-09-05
types.rule_text: Collect event with no Burn/DecreaseLiquidity and no swap in this transaction
types.what: A pool or position manager pays tokens already owed. Without a positive liquidity burn in this transaction, this is not evidence of new liquidity removal; owed principal from an earlier burn and fees require position history to separate.

types.name: deposit into a bridge toward another chain
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a bridge-deposit event family
types.what: Value is locked or burned on Ethereum and a message is sent so that it is released on another chain: an L2 deposit, a CCTP burn, a LayerZero packet.

types.name: bridge withdrawal finalized on Ethereum
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a bridge-withdrawal event family
types.what: Value locked elsewhere is released on Ethereum: an L2 withdrawal finalized, a CCTP mint, an OFT receipt, a relayer fill.

types.name: CoW Protocol batch settlement
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: Trade event from the settlement contract; event emitter must be the documented Ethereum settlement contract
types.what: A solver settles one or more signed orders against pools or its own inventory in one transaction; users' tokens move through the settlement contract.

types.name: intent, limit-order or RFQ fill
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: UniswapX Fill, 1inch OrderFilled or 0x fill events
types.what: A filler or market maker executes a user's signed order (UniswapX, 1inch limit orders, 0x RFQ): the user gets a quoted amount, the filler sources it.

types.name: par conversion through a peg-stability module
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #6
types.rule_text: BuyGem/SellGem event, or DSNote events with USDC and DAI/USDS legs and a mint or burn
types.what: A user exchanges one dollar stablecoin for another at exactly 1:1 through a protocol reserve (Sky PSM: USDS or DAI against USDC), typically burning one and drawing the other from a pocket; fee zero or a few basis points.

types.name: sandwich-pattern candidate
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: same block, same pool: actor swaps direction d at index i, a stranger swaps d at index k, the actor swaps -d at index j > k (scan marks front/back)
types.what: The same sending address trades opposite directions around another sender in one pool and block. This is a sandwich candidate; coordinated ownership, profit and the counterfactual execution price remain unproved.

types.name: swap inside sandwich-pattern candidate
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: swap in a pool between the front and back legs of a sandwich (scan marks victim)
types.what: A swap lies inside the detected same-sender round trip. Price harm requires replay against the state without the surrounding trades.

types.name: flash-loan-funded swap strategy
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #3, #8
types.rule_text: a flash-loan pair (same asset lent and repaid between the same two parties inside the transaction) and at least one swap event; lender must also emit a flash-loan event
types.what: An event-emitting lender sends tokens and receives at least the same amount back, while swaps occur. This establishes temporary funding plus trading; leverage adjustment or liquidation can have the same shape, so arbitrage profit is not assumed.

types.name: flash loan without a swap
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a flash-loan pair and no swap event
types.what: A flash loan used for something other than a pool trade: a collateral swap, a self-liquidation, a debt refinance, or a balance check.

types.name: positive observed-net multi-pool strategy
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: two or more swap events across two or more pools, no flash loan, the principal contract nets >= 0 in every priced asset and > 0 in one, the EOA nets nothing
types.what: The selected principal has a positive observed priced-asset net after multiple pool interactions. This is an arbitrage candidate; missing assets, internal ETH, claims, gas and bribes prevent a profit conclusion.

types.name: stablecoin issuance
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) (USDS mint inside the PSM path)
types.rule_text: a registry stablecoin transferred from the zero address for at least the threshold, no swap, no flash loan
types.what: The issuer creates new supply: tokens appear from the zero address, usually into the issuer's treasury, and reach the market in later transactions. This records token supply mechanics. Conversion, vault and credit operations can also mint or burn tokens; external fiat issuance or redemption is not established.

types.name: stablecoin redemption
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a registry stablecoin transferred to the zero address for at least the threshold, no swap, no flash loan
types.what: Supply is destroyed: tokens go to the zero address, the issuer having received them from a redeeming customer earlier. This records token supply mechanics. Conversion, vault and credit operations can also mint or burn tokens; external fiat issuance or redemption is not established.

types.name: wrapped BTC issuance or redemption
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a BTC wrapper minted from or burned to the zero address for at least the threshold, no swap
types.what: A custodian or bridge mints or burns a BTC-backed token (WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, LBTC) against bitcoin moved off-chain.

types.name: ETH staked with Lido
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: Submitted event
types.what: ETH is sent to the Lido pool and stETH is minted to the sender; from here the ETH is queued for validators.

types.name: Lido withdrawal request or claim
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: WithdrawalRequested or WithdrawalClaimed event
types.what: A stETH holder asks to exit (stETH locked, a request NFT issued) or claims finalized ETH.

types.name: stETH wrapped or unwrapped
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: wstETH minted or burned with a stETH leg and no swap
types.what: stETH is exchanged for wstETH (or back) at the current share rate; a wallet changes the form of its staked ETH, usually before a DeFi deposit.

types.name: validator deposit
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: DepositEvent from the deposit contract
types.what: ETH is deposited into the beacon deposit contract to activate or top up validators.

types.name: other liquid-staking or restaking operation
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: Rocket Pool, EigenLayer or ether.fi events, or an LST minted or burned
types.what: Minting or burning of rETH, cbETH, weETH, or a deposit into EigenLayer or ether.fi.

types.name: Aave v3 supply, borrow, repay, withdraw or liquidation
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #10
types.rule_text: an Aave pool event, no swap, no flash loan; event emitter must be the documented Ethereum Core pool
types.what: A user changes a lending position: supplies collateral (aToken minted), borrows (debt token minted), repays (debt burned), withdraws (aToken burned), or is liquidated (collateral seized by a liquidator who repays debt).

types.name: Morpho Blue market operation
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a Morpho Blue market event, no swap, no flash loan; event emitter must be the documented Ethereum Morpho Blue contract
types.what: Supply, withdraw, borrow, repay, collateral movement or liquidation on a Morpho Blue market (or a MetaMorpho vault that routes to one).

types.name: Compound v3 operation
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a Comet event, no swap, no flash loan
types.what: Supply or withdraw of base asset or collateral on a Comet market.

types.name: Spark (Aave-fork) operation
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: retired on the day run: its SparkSupply family shares the AaveSupply signature and can never match; see aave_fork_lending_op
types.what: Supply on SparkLend, recognised by its five-argument Supply event.

types.name: user swap through a router
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: swap event(s), no flash loan, the sending EOA nets negative in one asset and positive in another, destination is not the pool itself
types.what: An externally owned account sells one asset and receives another in one transaction through a router or aggregator; the EOA's own balances change on both sides.

types.name: swap by a contract principal
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: swap event(s), no flash loan, the destination contract nets negative in one asset and positive in another
types.what: A contract (smart wallet, vault, bot, treasury) is the party whose balances change on both sides of a swap; the EOA only pays gas.

types.name: swap sent straight to the pool
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: the destination emits the swap event
types.what: The transaction calls the pool contract itself rather than a router: a bot or an integrator that handles callbacks itself.

types.name: swap with an unclear principal
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: swap event(s) not matched by the rules above
types.what: Swap events are present but neither the EOA nor the destination ends two-sided: the beneficiary is a third address, or the priced legs are incomplete.

types.name: liquidity provided to a pool
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a liquidity-add event family and no removal family
types.what: Tokens go into a pool and a position (NFT, LP token or Curve shares) comes back.

types.name: liquidity withdrawn from a pool
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: a liquidity-remove event family
types.what: A position is burned or decreased and the tokens plus fees return to the owner.

types.name: Uniswap v4 liquidity change
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: ModifyLiquidity event
types.what: ModifyLiquidity on the v4 pool manager.

types.name: Balancer pool join or exit
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: PoolBalanceChanged event
types.what: PoolBalanceChanged on the Balancer vault.

types.name: deposit into an ERC-4626 vault
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: ERC-4626 Deposit event, no swap
types.what: Assets go into a vault and shares are minted to the depositor (yield vaults, sUSDe, sDAI, MetaMorpho).

types.name: withdrawal from an ERC-4626 vault
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: ERC-4626 Withdraw event, no swap
types.what: Shares are burned and assets return to the owner.

types.name: NFT sale
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: marketplace event plus a priced leg and no swap; an NFT transfer alone does not establish a sale
types.what: An ERC-721 or ERC-1155 changes hands against ETH or WETH through a marketplace.

types.name: account-abstraction bundle
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: UserOperationEvent
types.what: A bundler submits user operations to the EntryPoint; the value moves on behalf of smart accounts.

types.name: call on an EIP-7702 delegated account
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #7
types.rule_text: transaction type 0x4 (execution selector alone does not prove account delegation)
types.what: A type-4 transaction sets or uses a delegation, or a relayer calls execute() on an EOA that carries a delegation designator; the account owner moves value without paying gas.

types.name: multisig (Safe) execution
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: ExecutionSuccess or ExecutionFromModuleSuccess event
types.what: Owners of a Safe execute a signed transaction from the Safe: a transfer, a contract call, a treasury operation.

types.name: contract creation carrying value
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: no destination
types.what: A new contract is deployed and funded in the same transaction.

types.name: ETH wrapped into WETH
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #5
types.rule_text: actual canonical WETH Deposit leg, optionally native input, and one log
types.what: A wallet converts ETH to its ERC-20 form, usually inventory management by a trading wallet before a pool or bridge operation.

types.name: WETH unwrapped into ETH
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: the only leg is a WETH Withdrawal, one log
types.what: The reverse conversion.

types.name: transfer between high-connectivity wallets
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: plain native or single-token transfer; sender and recipient both carry hot_wallet or many_sources tags
types.what: Value moves between two high-connectivity addresses. Shared ownership or exchange identity cannot be established from these five-hour activity profiles.

types.name: withdrawal from an exchange-like hot wallet
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #2, #9
types.rule_text: plain transfer whose sender has the hot_wallet tag (>= 100 transactions to >= 50 distinct destinations in the window)
types.what: A hot wallet that sends to many destinations pays out to a customer address; the recipient is usually quiet. Exchange identity and customer intent are hypotheses; distributions, treasury operations and other services can share this behaviour.

types.name: deposit into an exchange-like wallet
types.origin: pilot iteration 2 (2-minute sample, 2026-09-05 09:31 UTC) #11
types.rule_text: plain transfer whose recipient has the hot_wallet or many_sources tag
types.what: A customer or a deposit address sends to a wallet that receives from many sources over the window. Exchange identity and customer intent are hypotheses; distributions, treasury operations and other services can share this behaviour.

types.name: sweep of a deposit address
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: plain transfer where either side is a pass-through address (few sources, one destination, net zero over the window)
types.what: A pass-through address forwards what it received to a collector: exchange back-office consolidation. Exchange identity and customer intent are hypotheses; distributions, treasury operations and other services can share this behaviour.

types.name: one sender paying many recipients
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: five or more distinct recipients, no swap, the principal only pays out
types.what: One transaction distributes an asset to five or more addresses: exchange batch withdrawals, payroll, airdrops, rewards.

types.name: plain transfer without a behavioural subtype
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: plain transfer with no actor tag matched above
types.what: A native or single-token transfer whose parties show no exchange-like, bot-like or pass-through behaviour over the window: OTC settlement, custody movement, a person moving funds. The largest class of unknown purpose; the profile of each side is the only evidence.

types.name: token moved by an operator (transferFrom)
types.origin: seeded 2026-09-05 from event shapes, before the window run
types.rule_text: selector transferFrom with at most two logs and no swap
types.what: A contract or operator moves a user's approved tokens: custody sweeps, subscription pulls, protocol deposits that do not emit their own event.

types.name: lending operation on an Aave-v3-fork pool
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.quant_notes: The inherited spark_op rule looked for a SparkSupply family that can never match because its signature equals AaveSupply; this entry replaces it.
types.rule_text: Aave-shaped pool event together with ReserveDataUpdated from an emitter other than the core pool, no swap, no flash loan
types.what: Supply, borrow, repay, withdraw or liquidation with Aave v3 event shapes emitted by a pool other than the documented Aave core pool. The window's occurrences are all at 0xc13e21b6…be987, which model memory identifies as the SparkLend pool; positions are USDS, cbBTC and wstETH in the $10M-$33M range.

types.name: swap recorded by an aggregator or venue event
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: an aggregator swap event family is present, no flash loan
types.what: An aggregator router (Kyber-style Swapped/Exchange, LiFi generic swap, 0x TransformedERC20, DODO) records the trade in its own event while the pools it used may emit no registered swap event. The audit found such transactions typed as bilateral exchanges; this entry precedes that rule.

types.name: issuance or redemption of a token priced from its own swaps
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: an implied-priced token minted from or burned to the zero address for at least the threshold, no swap
types.what: Supply of a token outside the registry is created or destroyed for at least the threshold, valued at its in-sample price; the window's cases are dollar-pegged tokens minted or burned by their issuer contracts.

types.name: deposit that mints an unpriced receipt token
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: no swap event, an unpriced token minted from the zero address, some address nets negative in a priced asset
types.what: A priced asset leaves the principal and a token the registry cannot price is minted in the same transaction: shares of a vault, fund or pool whose events the registry does not name. The audit found these typed as trades; a minted receipt is a claim, not a counterparty payment.

types.name: withdrawal that burns an unpriced receipt token
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: no swap event, an unpriced token burned to the zero address, some address nets positive in a priced asset
types.what: The reverse: an unpriced token is burned and a priced asset reaches the principal.

types.name: position or order opened with an NFT receipt
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: an ERC-721 transfer, a priced leg paid by the sender, no swap, no marketplace event
types.what: A priced asset leaves the sender and an ERC-721 is minted to the sender: a position, order or vault share represented as an NFT (the window's case routes WBTC into a 0x-Settler-style contract and mints the receipt).

types.name: claim of vested, distributed or reward tokens
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: a Claimed-style event family with tokens leaving the called contract, no swap
types.what: The called contract pays tokens it holds and emits a Claimed-style event: vesting, airdrop or reward distribution.

types.name: deposit recorded with a Relay-style deposit event
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: Relay-style deposit event from any emitter with value or tokens entering the called contract
types.what: A depository other than the documented Relay contract emits the same RelayNativeDeposit or RelayErc20Deposit shape as value enters it; the inherited relay_deposit rule pins one address, this entry records the shape wherever it appears.

types.name: withdrawal recorded with the observed Aster withdrawal topic
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: the observed Aster withdrawal topic from any emitter with priced token legs
types.what: Strategy or treasury contracts other than the documented Aster treasury emit the same withdrawal topic as tokens leave them to a user: the inherited rule pins one address, this entry records the shape.

types.name: trade whose other side is a token outside the registry
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: no registered swap event, no flash loan; some net payer of a priced asset receives an unpriced token, or a net receiver of a priced asset sends one
types.what: An address pays a priced asset and receives a token the scan cannot price (or the reverse) in one transaction, through a venue that emits no registered swap event: 0x-Settler-style anonymous logs, resolver fills that record per-account settlement events, OTC contracts. The trade is real but only one side is valued, so the position change overstates what the principal gave up.

types.name: operator moving approved tokens through Permit2
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: destination is the documented Permit2 contract, selector is transferFrom (single or batch), only transfer events
types.what: A relayer calls Permit2's transferFrom with a batch of (owner, recipient, amount, token) entries; users' tokens move under Permit2 allowances into one collector. The gas payer owns nothing; the asset owners approved Permit2 earlier. Seen as exchange or bridge deposit sweeps.

types.name: ERC-7821 execute() moving the account's own tokens
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: selector execute(bytes32,bytes), only transfer events, every priced leg leaves the called account
types.what: An EOA calls execute(bytes32 mode, bytes executionData) on an account and the account transfers tokens it holds. `resolve` found 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation designators on every account address in the packets (0xf90caf00…, 0x37e77355…, 0xafa1b5c1…, 0xd8eafb08…, 0x42bd41e6…, 0xc51e9af6…): these are EOAs delegated to an ERC-7821 implementation, executed by operator EOAs that pay the gas. The largest occurrences are USDC moves of $5M-$11M between the tiers of one custody stack.

types.name: custody vault sweep or payout by its operator ABI
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: one of three custody selectors (sweep, payout, withdraw), exactly one priced transfer that enters or leaves the called contract, only transfer events
types.what: A vault contract of one custody system either pulls an approved balance from a client address (sweep) or pays out under a signed instruction with deadline and nonce, or hands tokens to the calling hot wallet. Four vaults share the ABI; single transfers of $15M-$28M USDC between vaults are internal rebalancing.

types.name: payment routed through a contract that splits off a fee
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: one asset enters the called contract and leaves it to two or more recipients within 1%; the smallest share is at most 10%
types.what: A payer's tokens enter a router and leave it in the same transaction to a merchant and one or more fee takers; the router keeps nothing and records the invoice in its own events. The fee is the smallest share, under a tenth of the amount.

types.name: relayed transfer of approved funds recorded by the contract
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: only transfer events plus custom events from the called contract; every priced leg is third party to third party
types.what: An operator moves tokens from payers to recipients that are all third parties, and the called contract emits one record (often a 32-byte reference) per transfer. Neither the gas payer nor the contract holds the funds: a payment rail or settlement service executing instructions on approved balances.

types.name: sweep of per-customer forwarder contracts into a collector
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: every priced leg is paid by an address that emits a custom event in the same transaction and is neither the sender nor the destination
types.what: The paying address of every transfer is itself a contract that emits an event as it forwards: a deposit-forwarder pattern where each customer has a tiny contract and an operator sweeps them into a hub. The hub is the counterparty with many sources.

types.name: deposit into a service contract with a routing memo
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: calldata holds a printable memo of 8+ characters; value or tokens enter the called contract; the contract emits its own event
types.what: Value enters a contract that records the deposit, and the calldata carries a printable memo such as a destination chain, token and address (for example USDT(TRON)|<address>|0.05|bridgers|): a cross-chain swap or off-chain delivery order. The contract pays out on other orders through operator calls.

types.name: ETH sent with calldata into a contract that emits nothing
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: top-level value, calldata, no logs, destination tagged contract_like or router_like
types.what: A confirmed-successful call carrying ETH into a contract that is called by many and emits no log: a deposit contract without events (exchange, bridge or staking router). The window's cases are bots paying 13-52 ETH per call to one contract, dozens of times.

types.name: deposit into a contract without a record event
types.origin: day run round 4 (Claude): audit corrections and long-tail shapes, qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: only transfer events, every priced leg enters the called contract, no custom event
types.what: Tokens enter the called contract and nothing else happens: vault top-ups by hot wallets, converter deposits, escrow funding.

types.name: sUSDe cooldown claim (unstake)
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: destination is the sUSDe contract, selector unstake(address) 0xf2888dbb, a USDe leg is present
types.what: After the cooldown, unstake(receiver) on the sUSDe contract releases USDe from the silo to the receiver; the shares were burned when the cooldown started, so this transaction shows only the USDe leaving the silo.

types.name: delegated EOA executing a batch on itself
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: destination equals sender and at least one log
types.what: The transaction sender and destination are the same address and the call emits logs, which is only possible when the EOA carries an EIP-7702 delegation: the account executes a batch of transfers or settlements from its own code. Seen settling market-making inventory between several sub-accounts.

types.name: two-party exchange through a settlement contract without a swap event
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: no swap event, no flash loan, some address other than the destination nets negative in one priced asset and positive in another, two or more priced assets
types.what: One party pays asset X and receives asset Y while a counterparty does the reverse, both through a contract that records the order (RFQ fill, OTC settlement, limit-order match). No pool is involved, so no registered swap event fires; the ETH side may be delivered by unwrapping, which is invisible in receipts.

types.name: stake into a StakingRewards-style contract
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: Staked event and tokens entering the called contract, no swap
types.what: Tokens enter the called contract and it emits Staked(address,uint256): a farm or rewards contract records the position; rewards accrue off the ledger.

types.name: withdrawal from a StakingRewards-style contract
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: Withdrawn event and tokens leaving the called contract, no swap
types.what: The called contract emits Withdrawn(address,uint256) and returns tokens to the staker.

types.name: WETH received by a contract and paid out as ETH
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: a WETH Withdrawal by the called contract or by a contract that emits its own event, at most WETH legs into the called contract, no swap
types.what: WETH enters the called contract and the contract unwraps it in the same transaction; the ETH then leaves by an internal transfer that receipts do not show. The visible payer is often a liquidity wallet filling a cross-chain or off-chain order; the beneficiary is only visible in the contract's own event.

types.name: ETH deposited, wrapped and forwarded by a router
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: top-level value, a WETH Deposit credited to the called contract and WETH legs leaving it, no swap
types.what: Native value enters the called contract, which wraps it and passes the WETH on to a vault or strategy that records shares or totals in its own events. A deposit into a yield product whose events the registry does not name.

types.name: batched transferFrom sweep into one collector
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: only transfer events, every priced leg is third party to a single recipient, no custom event
types.what: An operator pulls approved balances from one or several customer addresses into a single collector in one call; nothing else happens and no event beyond the transfers is emitted. Exchange or payment-service deposit consolidation.

types.name: sender's own tokens sent through a contract call
types.origin: day run round 3 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: only transfer events, every priced leg is paid by the sender to addresses other than the destination
types.what: The transaction sender's tokens move to fewer than five recipients through a helper contract (multisend, app-specific transfer) that emits nothing else.

types.name: deposit into a contract that records it
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: value or tokens enter the called contract only, a custom event is emitted, no swap
types.what: Native value or tokens enter the called contract, nothing leaves, and the contract (or a registry it calls) emits its own event: custody hubs, bridge-like escrows, staking or trading-platform treasuries. What the deposit buys is not visible on Ethereum.

types.name: contract pays its own tokens to the calling address
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: every priced leg goes from the called contract to the transaction sender, only transfer events
types.what: The called contract sends tokens it holds to the transaction sender: a hot wallet replenishing itself from a vault, or an owner draining a contract.

types.name: contract-held tokens paid out by an operator call
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: every priced leg leaves the called contract to addresses other than the sender, only transfer events
types.what: An operator EOA calls a contract that pays tokens it holds to other addresses, usually with a per-payment record: withdrawal processors, treasury payouts, settlement of cross-chain orders. The recipient profile says whether the money reaches a fresh address (customer) or another hub.

types.name: operator-mediated transfer with custom events
types.origin: day run round 2 (Claude), qual_notes.md of research/2026-09-05/amount_outliers_eth_day
types.rule_text: only transfer events plus custom events; priced ERC-20 legs present; no rule above matched
types.what: Tokens move between third parties, or into and out of a contract, in a transfer-only transaction that also emits custom events the registry does not name. The residual mechanical shape of custody and settlement infrastructure.
